text:
Sam: quick design check — routing policies editor: compact rule-stack reordering is hard to discover. When you drag a rule it briefly jumps to the top before settling. repro in latest console staging. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE Any quick wins for clarity? Emma: saw that — I think the snap animation easing is misleading. Maybe show a placeholder ghost where it will land and keep the dragged item visible instead of snapping. Anya: agree re: ghost placeholder. Also the keyboard reorder (up/down arrows) doesn't announce position changes to screen readers. Dave can confirm but likely a11y issue. Dave: confirmed — VoiceOver reads "reordered" but not new position. Need aria-live updates like: ```
Rule 3 of 7
``` Also color contrast for the priority badge is 2.8:1 in dark mode; needs to be >=4.5:1 for small text. Kai: on the implementation side, the current list uses transform-based animation which reorders DOM after animation and triggers the flicker. We can keep DOM order stable and animate transform offsets — reduces jump. Will prototype a small patch. Emma: copy tweak idea: change the column label from "Priority" to "Order" and add a tooltip: "Execution order for routing rules (top = first match)". Thoughts? Sam: hmm worried about term collision with existing product docs that use "priority" for rate-priority tiers. Maybe "Order" + helper tooltip is safer. @Emma can you mock both variants? Emma: yup — will mock "Order" + tooltip and an alternate "Execution order" subtitle. Sharing by EOD. SimBot: preview-sim updated for thread 1968001234 — snapshot available: https://staging.redwood.infer/preview/1968001234 (include sample trace + timings) :white_check_mark: Anya: when running preview sim, the simulated trace shows last-run timings but not cache hit rate. We need cache hit % to explain why latency dropped in the canary run. Kai: adding cache metrics should be straightforward; will plumb from runtime tracing and expose a "cache hit rate" column in the sim view. ETA tomorrow. Dave: small a11y nit on preview panel: keyboard focus trap when opening simulated request details — focus doesn't return to the trigger after close. Should set focus back to the button and add focus outline. Also ensure modal has role=dialog and aria-modal=true. Sam: thanks — priority list: 1) fix reorder flicker (Kai), 2) keyboard a11y announce (Dave), 3) preview focus trap (Dave), 4) contrast + copy (Emma/Anya). I'll spin up tickets and link them to this thread. Emma: one more: simulation run with large rule sets (>50) times out in the UI; can we paginate rules in preview and show sampling indicator? :hourglass: Kai: noted. For previews we'll fallback to server-side sampling and surface the sample size + seed so the sim is deterministic. Will include a "Show full list" fallback with streaming. Anya: for keyboard reorder announcement, suggest aria-roledescription="rule item" and updating the live region with "Moved rule to position X of Y" — shorter messages are better for screen readers. Dave: agreed. Also add a test in the a11y checklist: move-by-keyboard announces new index, and focus returns after modal close. Sam: perfect. Can we sync 30m tomorrow to review Emma's mocks and Kai's prototype? 10:30 PT? Everyone: +1
